summary: A request the guest marked “It’s one night away” saved overnight=true, but the admin detail, the inbox row and the dates Lock sheet never said so; its lengths stopped at a day, so Jon would book a half day.
fix: The detail shows Away: one night away (with a pitch’s “Which night?” answer), the inbox row adds “one night away”, and the Lock sheet offers and picks a “one night away” length (24 h placeholder, within the lock API’s 72 h).
